name: Twin Oaks Shopping Center
demographics: Twin Oaks Shopping Center serves an affluent community in Agoura Hills, an upscale suburban area in western Los Angeles County. The primary trade area consists of upper-middle to high-income families with household incomes significantly above the national average, typically ranging from $100,000 to $200,000+. The visitor base skews toward educated professionals aged 35-65, with a strong presence of families with children who value convenience and quality. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for everyday necessities combined with specialty services, with frequent visits for grocery shopping, dining, fitness, and personal care services typical of affluent suburban lifestyles.
description: Twin Oaks Shopping Center is a strategically positioned neighborhood center located at the well-known intersection of Kanan Road in Agoura Hills, California, serving one of the most affluent communities in the Los Angeles metropolitan area. This thriving shopping destination has established itself as a cornerstone of the local community, offering residents convenient access to essential services and quality retailers in an attractive open-air setting. The center's tenant mix is carefully curated to meet the daily needs of its upscale clientele, featuring a diverse array of businesses including restaurants, salons, medical offices, and fitness facilities that cater to the health-conscious and quality-focused demographics of the area. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized leader in retail real estate development and management, Twin Oaks Shopping Center benefits from professional oversight and a commitment to maintaining a fresh, well-maintained shopping environment. The property's excellent visibility at a prominent intersection, combined with its location in the heart of Agoura Hills' residential areas, ensures strong and consistent traffic flow throughout the day. With a strong 4.3-star rating from nearly 600 reviews, the center has proven its value to the community as a reliable and pleasant shopping destination that continues to serve the evolving needs of this prosperous Southern California market.
summary: Twin Oaks Shopping Center is a strong neighborhood center strategically located at a well-known intersection in the affluent community of Agoura Hills, California. Managed by Regency Centers, this thriving open-air property serves the daily needs of upscale residents with a quality mix of restaurants, salons, medical offices, and fitness facilities.
